issue_fallback.no_progress: do not create a new evidence commit when no state bytes changed
issue_fallback.pre_effect_and_post_effect: repository readiness and external effect acknowledgement remain distinct
issue_fallback.resume: restore the prior issue-agent branch, fast-forward or merge current main history-preservingly, and resume from the persisted cursor

eligible: bounded input and bounded instruction path
no direct Git or platform effect
D3 preservation where the ABI requires it
host_adapter_only: Git commits, merges and ref updates
Zenodo, arXiv, IEEE, IETF or Wikipedia transport

clone_requirements: no transfer of PASS, FINAL_PASS or EFFECT_ACK_DONE

publication_handoff.closure_rule: A publication-required issue may become DONE only after publication_state=PUBLIC_VERIFIED and a committed effect receipt exists.
publication_handoff.effect_adapter_contract: M68000 selects READY/HOLD/REOBSERVE/REQUEST_AUTHORITY; the host adapter alone performs an exact authorized platform effect and must persist a public reobservation receipt.
required_ready_state: route is committed and exact-head bound
exact upload set is bound by Git blob identity
required repository gates are terminal non-adverse
network credentials are available only at execution
public record and bytes are independently reobserved

purpose: Eliminate coarse repository stalls, preserve one lossless Terminal Pattern with audience projections, derive portable pattern capsules, execute all eligible finite control decisions through proof-bound M68000 kernels, and autonomously publish an exactly authorized ready platform route.

source_basis.source_boundary: The owner PDF supports the virtual Mesh, append-only receipt/evidence model, explicit physical correspondence boundary and a historical Zenodo publication. M68000 compiler reuse is established by current repository evidence, not by silently treating the PDF as an ISA compatibility proof.

OPERATOR.content: exact binding, status, first blocker, next action and effect state

OWNER.content: effect class, first blocker, next action, machine-owned remainder and whether an owner decision is actually required

PUBLIC.content: bounded non-sensitive effect and evidence state only

WATCHDOG_FULL.content: canonical receipt including exact base64 payload bytes and hashes

preconditions: status payload is byte-bound by SHA-256
all nonterminal states name a first blocker or next action
sensitive values are excluded before public projection
